reviewer: opus, max reasoning effort — final QA/reflection pass over Case ② effort batch 006
verdict: ACCEPT WITH REQUIRED FOLLOW-UPS — do NOT persist any effort payload (this batch's or any prior batch's) until driverDefects #1 and #2 are closed. The batch's own headline work is real and largely verified: I independently re-derived the committees[] root cause and it holds; the money-gate corrections are genuinely applied in place; the convergence reasoning is honest rather than self-serving. The recurring driver pattern also recurs: every lesson was coded for THIS batch and not applied to the standing artifacts (prior payloads, handoff.md, code comments), which is where the two blocking items live.

driverDefects.finding: handoff.md was NOT updated for batch 006 (last write 2026-07-25 00:51, batch 005; `grep -c 'batch 006|batch-006' handoff.md` = 0). Two consequences. (a) batch-006.md line 48 states the committee_count double-count is 'escalated in the handoff, not fixed here' and ledger.md steering item (1) says the three ingest-scope gaps are escalated to Case ① — the handoff contains NO such escalation, so the escalation the batch claims to have made does not exist on the surface the orchestrator reads. (b) Far worse: handoff.md §1a still carries the standing instruction '### 1a. Army dossiers — 45 MPs (payloads/batch-005-props.json) — SAFE TO PERSIST'. I ran batch 006's own new Q-effort-14 regexes over that payload: 45/45 dossiers violate, 202 field-instances (65 raw prop identifiers, 51 raw pipeline field names, 47 batch/sample self-references, 26 internal case refs, 9 API/pipeline mechanics, 4 gate-rule citations). Acting on the standing instruction would persist, verbatim to voters, the exact defect class this batch declared closed.
driverDefects.recommendation: Write the batch-006 handoff section before anything else: retract the §1a SAFE-TO-PERSIST verdict on batch-005-props.json with the 45/45 measurement, and carry the three Case ① escalations with the numbers computed below. Until then the batch's escalations are asserted, not delivered.

driverDefects.finding: Q-effort-14 was written as a forward-only check. I ran the exact PIPELINE_JARGON regexes and PUBLIC_RENDER_FIELDS from gate.ts over batches 001-005 props: 001 → 5/20 dossiers, 5 instances; 002 → 15/30, 18; 003 → 33/35, 84; 004 → 35/35, 146; 005 → 45/45, 202. Total 133 of 165 prior dossiers, 455 field-instances — 4.6x the 99 instances batch 006 fixed in its own 42. Representative shipped text (batch 005, effort_notes, renders verbatim on /poslanec): 'Datová nesrovnalost: props uvádí committee_count=4, ale poskytnutý seznam committees obsahuje jen 3 položky (VEZ, ZAV, SKBIS)'; 'bills_authored=3 odpovídá počtu položek v sponsoredBills … (schema poznámka e)'; 'triage.tenureClass="replacement"'; 'Silné doporučení pro Case ①/Case ② pipeline'; 'contractCzk 0'; 'ověřeno přes ARES VR REST endpoint'. Severity is contained ONLY because ledger.md records 'No live write' for every batch 001-006 — this is latent, not live. It becomes live the moment persist-batch.ts runs, which handoff §1a currently authorises.
driverDefects.recommendation: Run gate.ts over batches 001-005 payloads and rewrite the 133 violating dossiers (with internals preserved in effort_analyst_note, same treatment as batch 006), or explicitly mark those payloads BLOCKED FOR PERSIST. A gate that only binds the batch that wrote it is a gate that has not yet fired.

driverDefects.area: code comments — the refuted root cause survives in the durable record
driverDefects.finding: The batch's best work — proving batch-005's 'excludes Podvýbor + ověřovatel' diagnosis wrong — did not reach the code. Four comment sites still assert the refuted mechanism: extract-dossiers.ts:51 ('influential_in edges … only cover organs that are DIRECT CHILDREN of the chamber, silently excluding Podvýbor (subcommittee) seats … that mismatch is the batch-005-root-caused extractor bug'); getProfileData.ts:54 ('silently drop Podvýbor seats'); getProfileData.ts:165 ('Using influential_in here undercounted (missed Podvýbor seats)'); contribution.ts:78 ('kg-compute.ts's direct-child-of-chamber influential_in edges, which silently drops Podvýbor seats'). None of the four mentions Delegace or duplicate rows — the two causes the batch actually established. contribution.ts:78 is the worst placement: it is written as a standing anti-fork instruction and therefore has the widest future readership. Also note the mechanism claim itself is wrong twice over: kg-compute's COMMITTEE_TYPE predicate is /v[ýy]bor|komis/i, which DOES match the substring 'výbor' inside 'Podvýbor' — Podvýbor organs would pass the type filter and are excluded only by the direct-child restriction, which is moot because 0 PSP10 memberships reference any of the 430 Podvýbor organs. ledger.md says 'three vault files had cited it'; the code files were not counted.
driverDefects.recommendation: Replace all four comments with the verified causes (Delegace excluded by /v[ýy]bor|komis/i while COMMITTEE_ORGAN_TYPES includes it, 39 MPs; duplicate member+function rows on one organ, 251/1062 pairs, 121 MPs) and drop the Podvýbor claim entirely except as a separate note that zero such memberships are ingested.

driverDefects.area: lib/analysis/contribution.ts + scripts/data-analysis/kg-compute.ts — the anti-fork comment forbids a fork that is still in the tree
driverDefects.finding: contribution.ts:78 now reads 'Do not fork this logic again — import isCommitteeSeat/isLeadership instead.' extract-dossiers.ts and getProfileData.ts comply. kg-compute.ts does NOT: it still uses its own COMMITTEE_TYPE regex to decide which organs are committees (the report line at kg-compute.ts:218 prints 'committee predicate = /výbor|komis/i'). The exact divergence the batch root-caused — Delegace counted by one definition and not the other — therefore still exists in the graph builder. Every downstream consumer of influential_in (degree centrality, organ.member_count, any future lens) still silently drops all delegation seats for 39 MPs.
driverDefects.recommendation: Make kg-compute.ts import isCommitteeSeat (or state explicitly why influential_in intentionally has a narrower definition and rename the edge/predicate to say so). Right now the codebase asserts a rule it does not follow.

driverDefects.area: features/profile/getProfileData.ts — dedupe merges role and current-ness from different rows
driverDefects.finding: The dedupe is described as 'each body ONCE at its highest role', but the write condition is `!prev || candidate.weight > prev.weight || (candidate.current && !prev.current)` and the merge is `{...candidate, current: candidate.current || prev.current}`. Two failures, both order-dependent, and this batch ships a live trigger. Jan Papajanovský (STAN), Výbor pro veřejnou správu a regionální rozvoj, three membership rows: chair with toAt 2026-03-06 (past), vice current, member current. (i) If the vice row is visited first, the chair row wins on weight and `current` is OR-ed to true → the page renders 'VSR · chair' at FULL opacity, i.e. asserts that a named MP currently chairs a committee he was demoted out of on 6.3.2026. His own effort_public_role in this same batch says the opposite ('od 14. 11. 2025 do 6. 3. 2026 předsedou … a od 2. 4. 2026 je místopředsedou'). (ii) If the chair row is visited first, the `candidate.current && !prev.current` clause overrides the max-role clause, the chair role is discarded entirely, and the past-seat de-emphasis feature the batch built never fires on the one case that motivates it. Either way the surviving record is a chimera: role from one row, current-ness from another. 13 past seats exist across the 42 dossiers, so the pattern is not exotic.
driverDefects.recommendation: Sort/compare on (current DESC, weight DESC) and take the winning row whole — never OR `current` across rows. Keep past seats as separate de-emphasized entries rather than folding them in. Add a unit test with the Papajanovský three-row shape.

driverDefects.area: batch-006-props.json — unconfirmed cross-case leads placed in a verbatim-rendered field

driverDefects.finding: Three things. (a) The docstring's stated reason for the script is false: 'a unit left at "triaged" would be re-dispatched by the next batch's triage run' — triage.ts:105 is `if (u.stage && u.stage !== "pending") doneIds.add(u.pspId)`, so any non-pending stage is already treated as done and nothing would be re-dispatched. The script's real value (recording per-unit signal, and printing both coverage numbers) is legitimate; the rationale is not, and a future session may act on a risk that does not exist. (b) `batch-00${batch}` breaks for batch >= 10. (c) It assigns `ledger.generatedAt` on a type that does not declare it (allowed only by the index signature). It was also run for batch 6 only, which is why ledger.json shows signal=127 / triaged=80 — batches 004 and 005 (35 + 45 = the exact 80) never had their signal scores recorded. Credit where due: ledger.md lines 33-37 disclose this gap explicitly and correctly rather than rounding coverage up.
driverDefects.recommendation: Correct the docstring, pad the batch number, and run `finalize-ledger.ts 4` and `5` so the two coverage counts converge and the per-unit signal history is complete (that history is the input to the convergence rule this batch just made executable).

driverDefects.area: gate.ts — the sibling lesson left in prose
driverDefects.finding: ledger.md's batch-006 entry says the 10 removed effort_low_score_reason:'unknown' values 'argue for a score precondition in code, not just a vocabulary check' — and then leaves it in prose. driverDefects.finding: The rebuilt committee block calls `store.listMemberships({termCode:'PSP10'})` and `store.listOrgans({limit:3000})` on every profile page render and filters in JS for one person. armyDefects.area: group-scoped superlatives rendered on a single-MP page — the residual public-copy class Q-effort-14 cannot see
armyDefects.finding: The token gate catches identifiers; it cannot catch a comparison scoped to an invisible partition. 42 dossiers were written in 9 groups of 4-5, and the prose repeatedly compares an MP to 'this overview'/'this group'/'the MPs observed' — a set that does not exist on /poslanec, where each MP renders alone. Counts across the shipped payload: 'v tomto přehledu' x8, group references ('z celé skupiny', 've skupině', 'v této skupině') x3, 'ostatní sledovaní poslanci' comparatives x3. Two are demonstrably FALSE at batch scale, i.e. the reader's only available reading is the wrong one: (1) Katerina Demetrashvili (group I), effort_public_role: 'nejmladší poslankyně v tomto přehledu (narozena 2003)' — Julie Smejkalová (group H) is described in the same batch as taking her mandate 've věku 21 let' on 4.10.2025, i.e. born ~2004 and younger. (2) Matěj Ondřej Havel (group G), effort_public_role: 'je tedy jediným poslancem v tomto přehledu, u kterého lze srovnat výkon v obou obdobích' — false batch-wide; Ryba, Hendrych, Olšáková, Šebelová, Farhan, Pošarová, Strýček and Fridrich all carry PSP9→PSP10 comparisons in this same payload. His effort_bill_focus adds 'ostatní poslanci v tomto přehledu jsou vždy jen spolupodepsaní' — also false; Rakušan's own dossier calls him 'skutečným předkladatelem tří tisků'. Also in this class: Šebelová 'má z celé skupiny nejvyšší přínosové skóre', Pošarová 'nejaktivnější profil ve skupině', Konečná 'má v této skupině poslanců nejvyšší počet', Ševčík 'odchyluje výrazněji než ostatní sledovaní poslanci', Papajanovský 'nižší přítomností než ostatní sledovaní poslanci', Hřib 'nejvyšší řečnickou aktivitu ze sledovaných poslanců'.
armyDefects.recommendation: Rewrite all 14 to either an absolute statement or a chamber-wide comparison computed from the deterministic props, and add the class to Q-effort-14 as a heuristic DROP (superlative or comparative + a scope noun: přehled / skupina / vzorek / sledovan* / zde uveden*). This is the same lesson as batch 005's, one abstraction level up: the leak survived because it was paraphrased rather than tokenised.

armyDefects.area: pipeline layer narrated to the reader in plain Czech
armyDefects.finding: Seven dossiers explain the duplicate-row artifact to voters in readable but internal terms: 'v podkladových datech figuruje jeden záznam dvakrát' (Konečná), 'je v podkladových datech uvedeno dvakrát — jednou jako místopředsednická role, jednou jako řadové členství' (Doležal), 'V podkladových datech je delegace … uvedena dvakrát' (Rakušan), plus Demetrashvili/Fridrich/Brázdil/Pražák 'odpovídá podkladovým datům'. Pošarová: 'dvojí zápis … odráží souběžnou členskou a vedoucí roli, ne chybu'. Kovářová: 'jde o obecné omezení metodiky, ne o chybu specifickou pro ni'. Horák effort_bill_focus: 'nebo datový duplikát'. Every statement is true and none contains a caught token — but a voter has no 'podkladová data' view, and the artifact is being explained instead of suppressed.

armyDefects.area: effort_low_score_reason vs the dossier's own prose

contradictionsWithPriorBatches.finding: batch-005-props.json contains ~28 dossiers whose effort_notes assert a DATA DISCREPANCY that batch 006 has now proven does not exist — e.g. Lipavský 'Datová nesrovnalost: props uvádí committee_count=4, ale poskytnutý seznam committees obsahuje jen 3 položky'; Wenzl 'committee_count=5 vs. 4 doložené položky … třetí výskyt stejného vzorce (počítadlo o 1 vyšší) v tomto vzorku pěti MPs … silně naznačuje systematický, ne náhodný extraktor artefakt'; Doksanský 'rozdíl tří nedoložených vazeb'; plus Slovák, Rázga, Peštová, Barták, Oulehlová, Hlavatý, Langšádlová, Oborná, Dvořák, Hoffmannová, Talíř, Ančincová. Those sentences are (a) now known to describe an extractor artefact rather than missing data, and (b) in the reader-facing field, and (c) in the payload handoff §1a marks SAFE TO PERSIST. Batch 005's reflection corrected 21 dossiers' *escalation* claims but left the discrepancy narration in the public copy.
contradictionsWithPriorBatches.recommendation: Fold into driverDefect #2's rewrite pass: those dossiers need the discrepancy sentences deleted outright, not just de-jargonised.

contradictionsWithPriorBatches.finding: batch-005.md's root cause ('excludes Podvýbor + ověřovatel roles') is contradicted by batch 006 and the contradiction is properly declared in batch-006.md and ledger.md — this is a correctly handled contradiction, and the driver deserves credit for reversing its own prior batch's confident finding rather than building on it. The residual problem is only that the reversal did not reach the four code comments (driverDefect #3), so the tree now holds both stories and the wrong one is in the more-read location.

batch-005 reported the committee mismatch as an off-by-one undercount ('počítadlo o 1 vyšší'); batch 006's mechanism predicts a variable overcount equal to the number of duplicated bodies. I confirmed the batch-006 mechanism against the data: across the 42 dossiers the gap between committee_count and unique organs is 1 in 14 cases, 2 in 5 cases, 3 in 1 case and 4 in 1 case (Chochelová, 10 rows / 6 bodies). The 'off-by-one' framing was an artefact of small samples, not a distinct class — worth stating so it is not re-derived a seventh time.

Group D's crossCuttingLead reports that the NEW extractor 'konzistentně vynechává podvýbory … a sněmovní funkce (ověřovatel)'. Half right, and worth pinning so it is not read as a regression: podvýbory are absent because zero PSP10 memberships reference one (ingest gap, not extractor), and chamber-level 'ověřovatel Poslanecké sněmovny' is out of scope because isCommitteeSeat filters on organType. Committee-level ověřovatel seats ARE included — I found 4 in the batch (Pipášová, Bartošová, Šebelová, Chochelová), which surfaces a separate small inconsistency: classifyRole maps 'ověřovatel' to 'member' (weight 0.3) while isLeadership counts it as leadership, so those four rows carry role:'member' with leadership:true, and getProfileData's max-weight dedupe can silently discard the ověřovatel row in favour of a plain member row.

dataQualityLeads.lead: committee_count double-counts leadership bodies — QUANTIFIED, and it is a genuine defect in the deterministic index, not a cosmetic one. psp.cz stores a leadership seat as two membership rows (kind:'member' + kind:'function') on the same organ; computeContribution's committeeCount counts rows. Effect: 21 of 42 dossiers carry at least one duplicated body. Because COMMITTEE_SATURATION = 3 and committee = clamp01(count/3) * 20, the inflation only bites below saturation — but there it is large and exact: 7 of 42 MPs (17%) have contribution_score inflated by exactly +6.67 of 100. Tureček 52.1 → 45.4; Pipášová 78.6 → 71.9; Pražák 71.3 → 64.6; Berkovcová 55.6 → 48.9; Horák 80.4 → 73.7; Farhan 62.6 → 55.9; Rakušan 75.4 → 68.7. Extrapolated to the population that is ~35 of 207 MPs whose published score, rank, z_vs_club and leaderboard position are wrong — and the bias is regressive: it inflates precisely the MPs holding leadership, who already receive the flat +10 leadership component.
dataQualityLeads.escalation: Case ① — CONFIRMED that escalation (not in-loop repair) is the right call, with one correction to the reasoning. Case gate (a) forbids this loop from changing computeContribution, and the batch honoured that. But the correct fix site is arguably NOT computeContribution: seats[] is assembled by kg-contribution-ingest.ts, and deduping seats by organ before the call would fix it without touching the scorer. That may fall outside gate (a) — however it would silently change every published score, so it still requires an explicit product decision plus a full regeneration and re-baseline of the leaderboard. Escalation remains correct; the ticket should say so rather than leaving a future session to conclude the fix is blocked when it is merely consequential.

dataQualityLeads.lead: Subcommittee memberships are absent from the ingest entirely: 430 Podvýbor organs exist, ZERO PSP10 memberships reference one. Independently reported by groups D, E, F, H and I. This is the largest single missing block of committee work, and for several MPs it is their ENTIRE leadership record: Adámková (chairs a health subcommittee from 21.1.2026), Gajdová (vice-chairs a social-services subcommittee from 28.1.2026), Strýček (chairs an economic subcommittee from 18.2.2026), Volpe (vice-chairs the public-finance subcommittee from 12.3.2026), Hubíková (chairs the animal-protection subcommittee), Fridrich, Brázdil, Tureček. All of them carry leadership_count = 0.
dataQualityLeads.escalation: Case ① — ingest scope. Correctly outside this loop's boundary.

dataQualityLeads.lead: leadership_count is blind to parliamentary-club leadership and to inter-parliamentary group chairs. Michaela Šebelová chairs the entire STAN parliamentary club and scores leadership_count via a committee ověřovatel seat only; Stojanová is Pirate club vice-chair; Jakob and Bartošová hold club leadership. Chochelová chairs the CZ–Chile group, Doležal the CZ–Montenegro group, Konečná the CZ–Moldova group. 'The MP who runs a parliamentary club has leadership_count = 0' is the most visible single defect in the published index and the one a journalist would find first.

dataQualityLeads.lead: Two live, disagreeing definitions of 'committee' in the same repo. COMMITTEE_ORGAN_TYPES = ['Výbor','Komise','Delegace','Vyšetřovací komise','Podvýbor'] vs kg-compute's COMMITTEE_TYPE = /v[ýy]bor|komis/i restricted to direct children of the chamber. They disagree on Delegace (matched by neither the regex nor the child restriction) — 39 MPs, 19 Delegace seats in this 42-MP sample alone. Every influential_in consumer is missing all delegation seats. Note 'Vyšetřovací komise' happens to match /komis/i, so Delegace is the sole type divergence.

dataQualityLeads.lead: Delegation role fidelity. Group F: Rajchl's NATO delegation seat is recorded twice with identical role and dates, and psp.cz describes his role as 'náhradník' (alternate) rather than 'member'. Chochelová's own dossier confirms the alternate→member transition is real data psp.cz carries ('nejprve jako náhradnice od 16. 1. 2026, členka od 24. 6. 2026'), so the alternate flag exists upstream and is being flattened to 'member' on ingest. An alternate delegate counted as a full member inflates committee_count and misstates a public role.

absence_rate and participation_rate look mutually inconsistent for several MPs and the pattern recurs. Papajanovský: absence_rate 0.8 with participation_rate 0.6 — and he is the batch's TOP scorer at 82.9. Tureček: both exactly 0.7 (his own analyst note flags the coincidence). Chochelová's dossier calls the combination 'neobvyklá'. Since attendance is (1 - absenceRate) * 10 and participation is participationRate * 25, a wrong denominator on either (excusedDays/sessionDays vs ballotsWithPosition/rollCallsHeld) moves up to 35 points. Worth an independent audit of the two denominators. Secondary: both rates are exposed to the army rounded to one decimal, which is coarse enough that units are reasoning about rounding artefacts.

External institutional oversight roles are invisible to the model. Trojan (VZP, SZIF), Šebelová (VZP board from 28.1.2026), Wenzl (VZP, batch 005), Pražák (SZIF supervisory board from 25.3.2026) all hold public-institution oversight seats that appear in no field. Pražák's is the highest-value instance: he joined the supervisory board of the very fund (SZIF) that channels ~154M CZK of subsidies to a company whose board he vice-chairs. That crossover is invisible to every deterministic lens.

symmetryAssessment: Checked four ways; the batch is broadly even-handed, with one real method asymmetry that is justifiable but undeclared. (1) Signal by club: KDU-ČSL 0.620 (n=1), TOP09 0.440 (n=3), ANO2011 0.434 (n=16), SPD 0.430 (n=4), STAN 0.379 (n=7), Piráti 0.346 (n=10), ODS 0.300 (n=1). No punitive skew; the spread is small and n is tiny outside ANO/Piráti/STAN. (2) Money-touching allocation: ANO2011 x4 (Tureček, Pražák, Petrtýl, Brázdil), TOP09 x2 (Jakob, Kučera), KDU-ČSL x1 (Horák), STAN x1 (Rakušan) — that mix follows linkedCompanies, not the analyst's hand. (3) Hedging language is applied consistently across clubs: Horák (KDU-ČSL) 'Bez data smlouvy se z tohoto souběhu nesmí vyvozovat střet zájmů'; Tureček (ANO) 'stojí za sledování … nikoli za obvinění na základě dnešních dat'; Jakob (TOP09) got the exculpating detail computed FOR him after the BLOCKING reversal ('skončila devatenáct dní předtím, než … poprvé usedl do Sněmovny'), which is the correct symmetric move — the correction found more evidence against him and the framing still landed where the dates land. Brázdil (ANO) carries the batch's best epistemics ('což znamená, že subjekt strukturálně leží mimo dosah tohoto zdroje, nikoli že byl vyčištěn') and it protects an ANO MP — good evidence against a punitive skew. (4) THE ASYMMETRY: the Hlídač-státu donation and subsidy sweep was run for exactly two dossiers, Petrtýl and Pražák, both ANO2011 — they are the only two dossiers in the batch that cite Hlídač at all — and both results were published as explicitly unconfirmed leads. No equivalent sweep is recorded for Rakušan (STAN, sitting Interior Minister and party leader, the batch's highest-profile subject), whose note is the most exculpatory in the batch, nor for Jakob, Kučera, Horák, Tureček or Brázdil. The asymmetry is almost certainly evidence-driven — Petrtýl and Pražák are the only two with ACTIVE commercial entities to sweep; everyone else's ties ended 2003-2016 or are non-commercial — but the batch never says so, so it cannot demonstrate that the extra depth was triggered by the evidence rather than by the target. That is the same doctrine gap Opus itself flagged for ARES ('k negativnímu nálezu vždy vypsat počet prošlých osobních záznamů, aby nenalezeno bylo odlišitelné od nehledáno'), and it applies with more force here because publishing unconfirmed material about members of one club only is the batch's largest reputational exposure. Fix is cheap and fully restores symmetry: record the sweep decision (run / not run, and why) in every money dossier, and hold both unconfirmed leads in effort_analyst_note until Case ① clears them.

steering.item: Nothing persists until the gate is retroactive. Run gate.ts (with Q-effort-14 widened per driverDefect #8) over batches 001-005, rewrite the 133 violating dossiers, delete the now-refuted 'Datová nesrovnalost: committee_count=N' sentences from ~28 batch-005 dossiers, and retract handoff §1a's SAFE TO PERSIST. Then run finalize-ledger for batches 4 and 5 so dossiered coverage (207/207) and signal coverage (127/207) converge. This is the single highest-value action after a completed population: the analysis is done, and the only remaining way to damage the product is to ship the backlog unchecked.

Rewrite the four Podvýbor comments (extract-dossiers.ts:51, getProfileData.ts:54 and :165, contribution.ts:78) to the verified causes; make kg-compute.ts import isCommitteeSeat so the anti-fork instruction stops being false; correct finalize-ledger's docstring; derive SIGNAL_HISTORY from ledger.json.

Fix the /poslanec committee render before anyone looks at it. The dedupe can assert that a named MP currently chairs a committee he was demoted from (Papajanovský, VSR, 6.3.2026) — sort on (current, weight) and take the winning row whole, never OR current across rows, and add a regression test on that three-row shape. This is the batch's only build output and it is the one thing that reaches a voter without a gate in front of it.

Ship ONE Case ① escalation ticket carrying the four ingest/index defects with the numbers already computed, so a future session does not re-derive them a seventh time: subcommittees 0 memberships / 430 organs; leadership_count blind to club and subcommittee leadership; committee_count double count = +6.67 points for 17% of MPs, ~35 of 207, regressive toward leadership holders; Delegace divergence between the two committee definitions, 39 MPs. Add Opus's mandate-history rule (never compute concurrency against the current term; load o=6..o=10 and compare against the FIRST mandate) — that single assumption produced both BLOCKING findings in this batch and will recur in every future money-touching dossier.

Add: group/sample-scoped superlatives and comparatives (the 14 instances above); self-described unconfirmed material in rendered fields; first-person analyst voice; and effort_work_themes / effort_data_flag to PUBLIC_RENDER_FIELDS. Then delete 'unknown' from LOW_SCORE_REASONS and add the score precondition the ledger already argued for — that is the sibling lesson still sitting in prose, and prose lessons have now failed twice in a row in this exact place.

qualityVerdict: Strong batch, honestly reported, with the defect profile of a driver that is excellent at the batch in front of it and weak at the standing artifacts behind it. What holds up under adversarial checking: the committees[] fix is real (I re-derived it — 0/42 mismatches confirmed from dossier-inputs.json; 21/42 dossiers carry duplicated organ rows and 9/42 carry Delegace seats, matching the claimed 121/207 and 39/207 population rates; two independent army groups reached the same duplicate-row conclusion); the Podvýbor refutation is correct and the mechanism claim in batch-005 was wrong for two independent reasons; the Q-effort-14 regexes have no false positives I could find and the shipped payload is 0/42 against them; effort_analyst_note is genuinely non-rendered; the money corrections are applied IN PLACE (I read all eight and both BLOCKING reversals are materially correct, not cosmetically appended); the convergence call is honest — the threshold was not back-fitted, the rule genuinely does not fire at K=2, and the batch says so; and ledger.md volunteers the 127/207 persist debt rather than rounding coverage up. That is a batch that did hard, expensive, self-correcting work. What it did not do is bind its own conclusions to anything outside batch 006: the new gate is not retroactive and 133 of the 165 prior dossiers fail it (455 field-instances); the escalations the batch says it made are absent from the handoff, which instead still authorises persisting the worst-offending payload; the refuted root cause survives in the four code comments a future session will actually read; the anti-fork rule the batch wrote is violated by the file it was written about; and the one thing built this batch can state a false current office for a named politician. The residual army defect is the more interesting one: batch 005's lesson was tokenised into code and the same leak returned as paraphrase — 14 comparisons scoped to a five-MP partition the reader cannot see, two of them false at batch scale (Demetrashvili 'youngest', Havel 'the only one'). Net: the analysis is complete and trustworthy; the shipping surface is not. Close driverDefects #1 and #2 before any persist, then #3-#5, and the population can be declared closed with a clean conscience.
